budget_arithmetic.historical_ledger_interaction: The -07-conserved ledger carries 8 credits under 2026-10-14 only; run-day (fresh UTC day) reservations start at 0, so the gate's ledger cross-check at dispatch is daily_usage >= same-day ledger reservations (0 on a fresh day, plus any same-day pilot spend if a future run day ever coincides).
budget_arithmetic.minute_composition: Status request conservatively assumed to occupy 1 minute credit in its observation minute; the run's pacing (<=8/min) remains enforced by the shared limiter; gate requires minute headroom >= 1 at observation.
budget_arithmetic.status_request_in_counters: The status request costs 1 credit from the same documented API-credit unit and daily pool. Whether its own response self-counts that credit is NOT documented; the gate therefore conservatively assumes it does NOT, and policy A requires reported daily_remaining >= 52 so post-check remaining >= 51.
budget_arithmetic.total_run_day: Policy A: 1 + 51 = 52 credits (of 800 tier day cap). Policy B: 51 total, data budget 50.

field_map.caveat: The docs text does not literally print the words 'per minute' beside current_usage/plan_limit; the pairing is derived by elimination (daily pair is name-labelled) plus the documented two-cadence limit structure. Recorded as derived, not documented.
field_map.documented_semantics: Usage counter paired with plan_limit; the docs prose describes the endpoint as returning 'the number of requests made, remaining requests, and the reset time' but the documented example carries exactly two counter/limit pairs and no reset field. The pair NOT named daily is the minute window: the only other cadence the vendor enforces (documented 8/min tier cap).
field_map.gate_use: Minute headroom: current_usage < plan_limit required at observation time.
field_map.label: derived with formula

field_map.documented_semantics: Limit paired with current_usage (minute window, derived as above). Example: 20000 on enterprise.
field_map.gate_use: Tier identity: must equal 8 (documented Basic-tier minute cap).
field_map.label: derived with formula
